name: moha
description: Hire in the UAE without a local company: the hiring guide, quotes, and an account prepared for the person to confirm, with Moha, an Employer of Record.

interface.shortDescription: Employer of Record in the UAE
interface.longDescription:
Moha is an Employer of Record in the United Arab Emirates. It employs people for companies that have no legal entity there. It signs the UAE employment contract, sponsors the work permit and the residence visa, pays salaries through the Wage Protection System and looks after people when they arrive.

With Moha, ChatGPT can:
- Explain how hiring in the UAE works without a local company, and what the employer and the employee need.
- Price a hire: the salary split, employer costs, government fees, health insurance, Moha's fee and VAT, with the upfront cost and how long the visa takes.
- Prepare a hire, or a whole account with the company profile, up to ten hires and the colleagues to invite. It returns one link. The person opens it, checks every detail and creates their account.
- Check whether a prepared hire or account has been confirmed.

Who it is for: founders, HR and finance teams at companies abroad that want to employ someone in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or elsewhere in the UAE, and recruiters placing candidates there.

Limits: Moha covers the UAE only. Quotes are estimates from published prices and official UAE government fees; the confirmed figures come with the offer letter. Nothing is charged, signed or sent to employees from the conversation. Moha checks every company before it can hire, and offer letters are approved in the Moha platform. Roles whose licence must sit with a facility, such as doctors and nurses, cannot be employed this way.
defaultPrompt: What does it cost to employ someone in Dubai if we have no UAE company?
How do we hire in the UAE without a local entity?
Set up our account and first hire in the UAE

positive.description: Price a hire for a company with no UAE entity
positive.prompt: My company is in Germany with no UAE entity. What would it cost to employ a software engineer in Dubai, Indian national, AED 25,000 a month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the monthly cost, the upfront cost and the visa time for the hire, stated as an estimate.

positive.prompt: How does hiring in the UAE work if we don't have a company there, and what documents will the employee need?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the steps, what the employer and the employee provide, and the usual timings.

positive.description: Prepare an account with a first hire
positive.prompt: Set up our account: Northwind Analytics, software, Germany, invoices to billing@northwind.example. I'm Hanna Weber, hanna@northwind.example. Hire Ravi Kumar, Sales Manager, India, AED 22,000, Dubai, from 1 March.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the company, the user and the hire, and returns one link for the person to check and confirm.

positive.description: Add a second hire to the prepared account
positive.prompt: Add Maria Santos too, Account Executive, Philippines, AED 14,000, already in Dubai.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an updated account with two hires, the total monthly cost and a new link.

positive.description: Check whether the prepared account was confirmed
positive.prompt: Did I finish creating the account?
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether the prepared account has been confirmed, or that it is still waiting for the person to open the link.

negative.description: Outside the UAE: Moha covers the UAE only, so it should say so and not prepare a hire
negative.prompt: Hire someone for us in Riyadh.

negative.description: No tool pays anyone: it should explain that salaries are paid through the Moha platform after the company is set up
Writing a job ad needs no Moha tool: the assistant should write it itself
negative.prompt: Write a job ad for a sales manager in Dubai.

review.commerce_description: Moha does not sell anything or take payments in the conversation. Quotes are estimates; invoices are issued in the Moha platform once a company is checked and has signed its agreement.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: the UAE hiring guide, quotes, and preparing a hire or a whole account for the person to confirm.

fr-FR.subtitle: Employer of Record aux EAU
fr-FR.description:
Moha est un Employer of Record aux Émirats arabes unis. Moha emploie des personnes pour le compte d’entreprises qui n’y ont pas d’entité juridique. Moha signe le contrat de travail émirien, parraine le permis de travail et le visa de résidence, verse les salaires via le système de protection des salaires (WPS) et accompagne les personnes à leur arrivée.

Avec Moha, ChatGPT peut :
- Expliquer comment recruter aux EAU sans entreprise locale, et ce dont l’employeur et le salarié ont besoin.
- Chiffrer une embauche : répartition du salaire, charges de l’employeur, frais gouvernementaux, assurance santé, frais de Moha et TVA, avec le coût initial et le délai du visa.
- Préparer une embauche, ou un compte complet avec le profil de l’entreprise, jusqu’à dix embauches et les collègues à inviter. Il renvoie un seul lien : la personne l’ouvre, vérifie chaque détail et crée son compte.
- Vérifier si une embauche ou un compte préparé a été confirmé.

Limites : Moha couvre uniquement les EAU. Les devis sont des estimations ; les montants confirmés figurent dans la lettre d’offre. Rien n’est facturé, signé ni envoyé aux salariés depuis la conversation, et Moha vérifie chaque entreprise avant toute embauche.

es-ES.subtitle: Employer of Record en los EAU
es-ES.description:
Moha es un Employer of Record en los Emiratos Árabes Unidos. Emplea a personas para empresas que no tienen una entidad jurídica allí. Firma el contrato de trabajo emiratí, patrocina el permiso de trabajo y el visado de residencia, paga los salarios a través del sistema de protección de salarios (WPS) y acompaña a las personas cuando llegan.

Con Moha, ChatGPT puede:
- Explicar cómo contratar en los EAU sin una empresa local, y qué necesitan el empleador y el empleado.
- Calcular el coste de una contratación: el desglose del salario, los costes del empleador, las tasas gubernamentales, el seguro médico, la tarifa de Moha y el IVA, con el coste inicial y el plazo del visado.
- Preparar una contratación, o una cuenta completa con el perfil de la empresa, hasta diez contrataciones y los compañeros a invitar. Devuelve un solo enlace: la persona lo abre, revisa cada detalle y crea su cuenta.
- Comprobar si una contratación o cuenta preparada se ha confirmado.

Límites: Moha cubre solo los EAU. Los presupuestos son estimaciones; las cifras confirmadas llegan con la carta de oferta. Nada se cobra, se firma ni se envía a los empleados desde la conversación, y Moha revisa cada empresa antes de cualquier contratación.
